main_text.p: mũ subtiles, diserti & in concitandis affectibus acres, ve hementes, & imperuosi esse confuerunt: ut imbecilles & incautos animos mouere & percellere possint. Hafce autem qualescunq; dotes, quæ in sincerę pietatis schola nō perinde æstimanda sunt, corrumpit & corda-tioribus suspectas facit, primum Elocutionis siue actionis (hanc quidam hypocrifin vocari dicunt) gesticulatoria leuitas, nimiumq; fu-candi sermonis studium, & qui sub hoc prælu-cet, ardentissimæ ambitionis affectus. Quorum vtrunq; nescio quid non Apostolicum sa-pit. Deinde deformat eas ista inexhausta calumniandi & conuitiandi libido, qua plerumque in aduersarios debacchantur. Idq; tantum vt plebis animos incendant & exasperent: cum interim aduersarios, quos lucrari debebant, magis indurent. Me quidem hæc ita offendut, vt vilissimi pagi parochum interdum concionantem audire malìn, quàm qui in vniuersa Polonia inueniri queat, disertissimum lesuitam.

Decæpula Confessionaria.Ad confessionarium artificium quod attinet, non inficiaseo, hoc venationis Iesuiticæ præcipuum instrumentum & perquàm com-*modum rete esse. Neq; tamen hoc ipsum tam caute hactenus disponere potuerunt, ut illa omnium arcanorum perscrutatio peccatorumq; interdum non satis pudicum examen, cùm satisfactionis illa infidiosa, multoties etiam aud-ra impositione, non plurimos offenderit & à

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "Decæpula" (marginal note heading, possibly misprinted); "vc hementes" read as "ve hementes"; "sincerę" (æ/ę ligature unclear); "ista inexhausta" and "offendut" are doubtful; "malìn" as printed; "aud-ra" at line end is hard to read. The asterisk after "perquàm com-" is a reference mark with no matching note on this page. A small stray mark "r" sits below the last line, not transcribed. The text ends at the bottom of the page, with "à" as the last word of a paragraph continuing on the next page, so no catchword is shown.
